sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the strict 20 deg < framingAngle < 70 deg applicability, preserves mandatory single-valued angle evidence, conditionally requires all declared readiness operands, endpoint relationships, and result, and correctly avoids requiring every ship to have an interpolation case.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove sh:minCount 1 from the ship-level hasObliquePlatingInterpolationCase property shape. The requirement conditionally governs existing oblique-plating cases and does not independently require every ship to have such a case; retain the path, class, and nested case validation so any linked case is checked.

Encode the strict applicability condition 20 deg < framingAngle < 70 deg.
